field.label: Enable SMS Scheduler
field.comment: Enable to restrict SMS sending based on time schedule.

field.label: Restrict From Time
field.comment: Start time for SMS restriction (e.g., 21:00 for 9:00 PM). SMS will be queued if sent during restriction period.

field.label: Restrict To Time
field.comment: End time for SMS restriction (e.g., 10:00 for 10:00 AM). SMS will be queued if sent during restriction period.

field.label: Timezone
field.comment: Timezone to use for time restriction. Default is Asia/Kolkata.

field.label: Send Queued SMS Time
field.comment: Time when queued SMS should be sent (e.g., 10:01 for 10:01 AM). This should be after the restriction end time.

field.label: Max Retry Attempts
field.comment: Maximum number of retry attempts for failed SMS. Default is 3.

field.label: Cron Security Token
field.comment: Optional security token for cron URL. Leave empty to disable token validation.
